name: Claude
description: Claude is Anthropic's conversational AI assistant for everyday work: writing, learning, research, and analysis. Available on web, desktop (macOS, Windows), and mobile (iOS, Android), it supports voice mode, projects, artifacts, citations, and file uploads (PDF, Word, Excel, images). Free, Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise plans scale from casual use to organization-wide deployment.
features: Web search and Google Workspace integration
Voice mode, artifacts, and projects
File uploads: PDF, Word, Excel, images
Memory across conversations
Desktop apps for macOS and Windows; mobile apps for iOS and Android
Access to the full Claude model family (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable, Mythos)
highlights: Free tier available, Pro from $17/month
Import memory when switching from another AI provider
Extended thinking for complex problems

name: Claude Code
description: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding assistant that works directly in your codebase — terminal, IDE, web, mobile, Slack, and GitHub. It reads, writes, and executes code, runs tasks across parallel subagents, maps and explains entire codebases, and opens pull requests end-to-end. Runs locally and talks directly to model APIs without a remote code index.
features: Agentic multi-file editing and codebase understanding
Routines: scheduled or event-triggered automated tasks
Fast Mode: 2.5x faster Opus configuration for rapid iteration
Computer use: opens apps, navigates browsers, runs dev tools
IDE extensions for VS Code and JetBrains; GitHub Actions integration
Issue-to-PR workflows: reads issues, writes code, runs tests, submits PRs
highlights: Pro from $17/month (annual), Max plans from $100/month
Used by Spotify, Rakuten, Notion, Shopify, Ramp, HubSpot
Rakuten cut time-to-market from 24 days to 5 days

name: Claude Cowork
description: Claude Cowork is an agentic productivity tool that completes multi-step knowledge work autonomously — reading, editing, and creating files directly in folders you specify, and connecting to external tools. Designed for non-coding professionals in marketing, sales, legal, and finance, it splits large projects into parallel sub-tasks and runs in the background, even when your laptop is closed.
features: End-to-end task completion in your files and tools, not just chat
Background and scheduled/recurring task execution
Parallel execution of sub-tasks across a project
Plugin system bundling skills, connectors, and sub-agents
Cross-platform continuity across web, desktop, and mobile
Transparency: shows every step, file, and decision made
highlights: Included with Pro ($20/mo), Team ($20/seat/mo), and Enterprise
Used for marketing decks, sales briefs, legal audits, finance reconciliation
User approval required before deleting files

name: Claude Platform (API)
description: The Claude Platform is Anthropic's developer-facing API for integrating Claude's model family into custom applications and workflows. It offers prompt caching, web search, advanced tool use, batch processing, memory, the Files API, structured outputs, and an MCP connector — plus the Claude Console workbench for building, testing, and evaluating prompts. Usage-based pricing scales from self-serve to sales-supported enterprise deployment.
features: Claude Managed Agents: composable APIs for building agents at scale
Prompt caching and batch processing (50% cost savings)
Web search and fetch tools for real-time data
Files API and structured JSON outputs
MCP connector for remote tool servers
Code execution: run Python and generate visualizations in-call
highlights: Sonnet 5 at $2/MTok input introductory pricing
Used by Cursor, StubHub, Thomson Reuters, Databricks, Replit, Intercom
Self-serve or sales-assisted onboarding paths

name: Claude Science
description: Claude Science (beta) is a desktop research application — 'your research partner for rigorous science.' It runs analyses, searches 60+ scientific databases, and maintains full reproducibility from data wrangling through publication, with native rendering for proteins, molecules, and structures. Pre-configured for genomics, single-cell, proteomics, structural biology, and cheminformatics workflows.
features: Reproducible artifacts: exact code, environment, and conversation preserved
Background reviewer flags incorrect citations and untraceable numbers
Manages compute on laptops, HPC clusters, or Modal accounts via SSH
Persistent Python and R kernels across an analysis session
Manuscript drafting alongside underlying analysis with LaTeX preview
Query access to 60+ scientific databases
highlights: Available for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Linux
Pre-configured for single-cell RNA-seq, phylogenetics, protein structure, cheminformatics
Contact sales for enterprise research lab deployment

name: Claude Design
description: Claude Design (beta) lets teams collaborate with Claude to create visual work — designs, decks, prototypes, and documents — through natural language descriptions and iterative refinement. It imports design systems from GitHub or local codebases so output uses real components and brand styling, and syncs directly with Claude Code via /design-sync.
features: Natural language to visual: describe what you need, refine the draft
Design system import from GitHub, design files, or codebases
Claude Code synchronization via /design and /design-sync commands
Fine-grained editing: comments, sliders, drag/resize/align
Export to PDF, PPTX, or HTML; connectors to Adobe, Canva, Figma-adjacent tools
Admin-locked design systems for brand consistency
highlights: Included with Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise subscriptions
Used for prototypes, pitch decks, marketing collateral, wireframes
Enterprise admins enable it manually in Organization settings

name: Claude Security
description: Claude Security (public beta) is an AI-driven code security scanner for Claude Enterprise customers. It traces data flows across files to find complex, multi-component vulnerabilities that traditional rule-based scanners miss, runs every finding through an adversarial self-verification pass to cut false positives, and proposes reviewable patches for each issue found.
features: Context-aware scanning that traces data flow across files
Adversarial finding verification to reduce false positives
Patch generation with human approval required before implementation
Webhook integration with Slack and Jira; CSV/Markdown export
Scoped or scheduled scans on specific directories
Documented dismissals carried forward across tool runs
highlights: Public beta for Claude Enterprise customers
Team and Max plan access listed as coming soon
Finds memory corruption, injection flaws, auth bypasses, logic errors

name: Claude Code for Enterprise
description: Claude Code for Enterprise brings agentic coding to large engineering organizations with centralized management: contribution metrics dashboards, server-managed tool permissions, OpenTelemetry monitoring, SSO/SCIM provisioning, and audit trails. SOC 2 Type II compliant with TLS 1.3 in transit and AES-256 at rest, plus bring-your-own-key deployment via Bedrock, Vertex AI, or Microsoft Foundry.
features: Contribution metrics dashboard for usage, PRs, and committed code
Server-managed settings: tool permissions, file access, MCP configs
OpenTelemetry export for session activity, token usage, and cost
SSO (Okta, Azure AD, SAML 2.0) and SCIM automated provisioning
VPC isolation and private endpoints; no training on customer data
Role-based permissions and audit trails
highlights: Team plan from $100/person/month, Enterprise custom pricing
Rakuten: 24 days to 5 days time-to-market, 99.9% accuracy
Zapier: 89% employee adoption, 800+ AI agents deployed
